0.0: I am the master of my domain at recycling throwaway machines into something totally new. Lately I've been working on recycling the fuel of MT-09 for something, but I desperately need more people to help me out here. Say, would you like to work for me as my assistant?

yes.0: Okay, nice! I've been waiting for someone like you, actually, and this is going to be great! I'll be counting on you as my trusty assistant. Anyway, here's your first task. I told you something about recycling the fuel of MT-09, right? Well, I need the materials necessary to conduct the studies, and therefore I've been delaying it for a while now.
yes.1: You can get to the secret area where #rMachine MT-09s#k are by using the secret entrance in #b#m221030600##k. Can you defeat some of the #o5120100# monsters and bring back 5 of the #b#t4000126##k items? I'll keep working here while you're gone.

no.0: Hmmm... I think you can be a great assistant for me... you must be really busy right now. Please remember that for the sake of Omega Sector, we really need your help, so if you change your mind, please tell me so.

1.0: You're finally back. Let's see... yes, this is indeed #b#t4000126##k, the fuel for the aliens. With this, we can seriously make new machines for our benefits. Great job collecting these for me. Since you did your job as my 'assistant', I'll give you some items directly from my bosses. These will indeed help you out.

yes.0: Okay, so the first assignment is finished...but you're still my assistant! I know I'll need your help again in the future so don't be a stranger! See ya!

item.0: I don't think you have gathered up the necessary items for my research. Find the hidden fields around Omega Sector. Every once in a while, you'll run into a machine called #b#o5120100##k. Defeat the machine, and collect #b5 #t4000126#s#k in the process, okay? I'm counting on you!

QuestInfo.name: Fuel for MT-09
QuestInfo.0: Go visit Engineer Kay in Omega Sector #m221000200#.
QuestInfo.1: You ran into an engineer named Kay in Omega Sector Silo. She happened to need an assistant, so you agreed to help. You first need to retrieve 5 #bMT-09's Fuel#K items for Kay's recycled machine research. She says that you can find #rMachine MT-09's#k through the hidden entrance in #b#m221030600##k.
QuestInfo.2: I went around and collected the fuel for MT-09. This was for Kay the Engineer, who was at the Silo of the Omega Sector. I wonder what kind of a machine Kay will make with the fuel...
